Pending.label: Awaiting payment
Pending.hint: The buyer has not uploaded a transfer slip yet

Pending Refund.label: Awaiting refund
Pending Refund.hint: Waiting on the seller to transfer the money back

Waiting.label: Ready to collect
Waiting.hint: Show your QR to the giver within the pickup window

Registered.label: Registered
Registered.hint: In the draw, not chosen yet

FirstCome.label: First come, first served
FirstCome.hint: Places are given in the order people register

Random.label: Random draw
Random.hint: Drawn at random when registration closes. Registering early makes no difference.

Manual.label: Giver picks
Manual.hint: The giver chooses recipients from the list of people who registered

Pending.label: Awaiting confirmation
Pending.hint: The other side has not answered this meetup yet

Closed.label: Entries closed
Closed.hint: Recipients have been chosen; collection is still open

Suspended.label: Suspended
Suspended.hint: Access returns automatically when the suspension expires

Banned.label: Banned
Banned.hint: The email is locked and cannot register again

Warning.label: Warning
Warning.hint: Recorded on the account; access is unaffected

Suspend.label: Suspension
Suspend.hint: Access is blocked until the expiry date, then restored

Ban.label: Permanent ban
Ban.hint: History is kept and the email is locked against re-registration

Expired.label: Expired
Expired.hint: Renew to get the tier benefits back

Pending.label: Slip under review
Pending.hint: An admin is checking your transfer

Reject.label: Slip rejected
Reject.hint: The amount did not match; send a new slip

enter-tracking.them: Waiting on the seller to enter a tracking number

confirm-delivery.them: Waiting on the buyer to confirm delivery

scan-qr.them: Waiting on the meetup and QR scan

refund-slip.them: Waiting on the seller to transfer the money back

seller-confirm-payment.label: The seller must confirm payment within 24 hours

cancel-response.label: The other party must respond to the cancellation within 72 hours

feed.title: Find it on campus
feed.subtitle: Secondhand finds, trades, and giveaways from verified KU students.
feed.searchLabel: Search by item name or course code
feed.searchPlaceholder: Search by item name or course code, e.g. 01417111
feed.emptyBody: Try removing a filter, or search by course code instead of the book title. People name their posts differently.

card.verified: Verified with a KU email address

deal.wherePlaceholder: e.g. สำนักหอสมุด มก. (หน้าประตูทางเข้าหลัก)
deal.whereHint: Somewhere public and busy on campus
deal.meetupProposed: Meetup proposed. Waiting on a reply.
deal.stepUploadSlip: Your step - pay and upload the slip
deal.stepEnterTracking: Your step - enter the tracking number
deal.stepConfirmArrived: Your step - confirm the item arrived
deal.stepScanQr: Your step - scan the QR at handover
deal.stepRefundSlip: Your step - refund and upload the slip
deal.noMoneyExplainer: There is no money in this trade, so the next thing to settle is where and when you swap.
deal.trackingHint: The buyer sees this the moment you save it
deal.confirmArrivedBody: Did the parcel arrive and match what was agreed? Confirm to close this deal.
deal.letBuyerScanTitle: Let the buyer scan to close the deal
deal.letBuyerScanBody: Hand the item over first. Scanning closes the deal immediately and cannot be undone.
deal.cancelBody: The other side has 72 hours to respond. If they do not, it goes to an admin.
deal.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. I can no longer make the meetup
deal.reasonHint: A reason helps a lot. If the other side rejects it, this is the context an admin will see.
deal.photoLimit: Only the first 5 photos were attached.
deal.slipRejectUnsupported: Rejecting a slip is not supported yet. Ask the buyer in chat, or request a cancellation.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Clear a filter, or start something in the market — a room opens by itself when you buy or when an offer is accepted.

chat.photosExpired: Photos from this message have expired and are no longer shown.

slip.formats: JPG or PNG, up to 8 MB
slip.check: Check the slip and confirm payment
slip.viewInNewTab: View the full slip in a new tab

delivery.reportAfter: You can report a problem after this

qr.typeCode: Type the code from the QR

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.selectHint: Pick the items you want to handle together, then choose an action.
inventory.emptyBody: Put what you own in here first. Later you decide whether to sell it, open it to trades, or just keep it.
inventory.privateItemHint: Only you can see this item until you publish a listing.
inventory.listedHint: This item is visible in the market and ready to receive buyers or offers.
inventory.unlistedHint: Keep it private, or publish it whenever you are ready.
inventory.handedOver: This item has been handed over and is kept for your records only.
inventory.courseHint: Most people search by course code. Adding it makes this far easier to find.
inventory.warrantyHint: Leave empty if it is out of warranty or never had one
inventory.sizeHint: Whatever the label says. This is the question every buyer asks first.
inventory.conditionHint: Condition shows as the border colour of the item, in your inventory and in the market. Be honest and the meetup goes smoothly.
inventory.descHint: Say honestly how long you have had it, what is wrong with it, and anything the next owner should know

listing.kind: What kind of listing is this
listing.both: Buy it or trade for it. One post accepts both.
listing.wantInTrade: What do you want in trade
listing.wantPlaceholder: e.g. Chemistry 1 textbook, or Calculus 2 notes
listing.wantHint: Being specific filters out a lot of offers that miss the mark
listing.descPlaceholder: Meetup conditions, times that suit you, or anything else worth saying
listing.priceHintBoth: This price applies to a direct purchase. Someone offering a trade proposes their own cash difference.

offer.title: Offers
offer.inboxHint: Compare both sides of every trade and see which offers need your decision.
offer.confirmTradeBody: A trade is always handed over in person. Accepting declines every other offer on this post and opens a chat room.
offer.emptyStashBody: You need items in your inventory before you can offer a trade. Add some, then come back to this post.
offer.tapToPlace: Tap an item to put it on the table
offer.tapToRemove: Tap an item to take it back
offer.composeHint: Choose from your inventory, compare both sides, then add cash only if it helps balance the deal.
offer.yourExtraCash: Extra cash you add, in baht
offer.theirExtraCash: Extra cash they add, in baht
offer.acceptedBody: You are trading with {name} for {item}, handed over in person. Every other offer on this post is declined and a chat room is open.

market.safeDealHint: Check the item and agree on payment details in chat before completing the deal.
market.chooseDelivery: Choose how you will get it
market.chooseDeliveryBody: This cannot be changed later. The steps after this differ depending on what you pick.
market.meetupBody: Meet on campus, inspect before paying, finish by scanning the seller QR
market.shippingBody: Pay first, upload a slip, the seller confirms and posts it with a tracking number
